title: Contract repository
requirement: Contracts (number, name, type, supplier, legal entities covered, currency, start, end, value ceiling, owner, renewal terms, documents and clauses as attachments, custom fields) shall be maintained with approval (new and change) and publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given mandatory fields, When saved, Then the contract is Draft with a number at submission.|Given an end date before start, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given publishing, When done, Then items become orderable.

title: Contract items and pricing
requirement: Contract items (item or description, unit, price, currency, validity, quantity or value ceiling per item) with price tiers by quantity and validity.
acceptance_criteria: Given tiers 1 to 99 at 10 and 100 plus at 9, When a line of 150 is created, Then price 9 applies.|Given a duplicate item in a contract, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given validity ended, When picked, Then the item is not offered.

title: Contract approval and publishing
requirement: New contracts and changes run the contract approval configurations; only published contracts are offered; unpublishing hides items but keeps references on existing orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given approval, When published, Then items appear in browsing.|Given a contract unpublished, When an existing order is viewed, Then its reference remains.|Given a change to a published contract, When saved, Then it runs the change approval and the published version stays until approval. (edge)|Given publishing attempted before approval, When requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract documents and clauses
requirement: Contracts hold documents (signed copies, amendments) and key clause fields (liability cap, payment terms, termination notice) as structured attributes for reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Given clause fields, When filtered in the list, Then matching contracts appear.|Given a signed copy uploaded, When viewed, Then it is listed with version.|Given a document deleted, When attempted on a published contract, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract import
requirement: Contracts and items importable through the import framework.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid file, When imported, Then contracts and items exist as Draft.|Given an unknown supplier, When imported, Then the row is reported. (error case)|Given a dry run, When finished, Then nothing is created.

title: Contract applicability per organisation
requirement: Contracts shall list the organisations they cover; contract consumption is tracked per organisation and in total.
rationale: Different units buy from different agreements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a contract covering A and B, When an order of C references it, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given consumption by A and B, When the contract is viewed, Then per-organisation and total consumption are shown.
notes: Was FF-186, the contracts; the catalogues are CAT-007.

title: Quality agreements
requirement: With Supplier management's regulated qualification (its licensed feature `supplier_management.gxp_qualification`), a contract of the type quality agreement shall name the supplier, the manufacturing sites and the quality-relevant materials it covers, each a combination on Supplier management's approved supplier list, whether pending or approved (SUP-183); it runs the contract approval with the quality unit among its approvers, and its publishing, expiry and termination are published as events, from which Supplier management shows each combination's agreement in force.
rationale: EU GMP chapter 7 asks for a written agreement for outsourced activities, and a regulated buyer's inspector asks for the quality agreement behind each approved supplier and site. The agreement is a contract; its link to the qualification lets the quality unit see both in one place.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quality agreement covering supplier S, its site in Pune and material API-123, When it is published, Then its event names the agreement and the combination, and the combination shows the agreement in force.|Given a published quality agreement whose end date passes, When the expiry job runs, Then its expiry is published as an event naming the combinations it covered.|Given a quality agreement naming a combination that is not on the approved supplier list, When saved, Then it is refused naming the combination. (error case)|Given a quality agreement whose approval chain has no approver from the quality unit, When it is submitted, Then it is refused naming the missing approver. (error case)
notes: New 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, gap G3 of the supplier management pack). Contracts calls Supplier management, the earlier product, to check the combinations (ADR-0042); Supplier management hears of the agreement through these events (`CON-007 (event)` in SUP-183). Decision: an agreement may cover a combination still pending, since agreements are often signed before approval; the quality unit approves every quality agreement; the owner confirms.

title: Contract consumption
requirement: Released quantity and value accumulate from issued order lines referencing the contract and release on cancellation or close-short; thresholds (for example 80 percent) alert the owner; exceeding the ceiling blocks or warns per setting.
rationale: Know when a contract runs out.
acceptance_criteria: Given 80 percent reached, When the next order is issued, Then the owner is alerted.|Given 100 percent reached with blocking, When an order is submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given an order cancelled, When processed, Then the consumption is released.
notes: Was FF-143. Orders records each release and its cancellation through this product's Contracts (ORD-008); this product never calls Orders (ADR-0042). Decision F-07 confirmed.

title: Expiry and renewal alerts
requirement: Contracts expiring within 90, 60 and 30 days shall alert owners; a renewal creates a new version with new dates and optional price changes while keeping history.
acceptance_criteria: Given 60 days to expiry, When the job runs, Then the owner is notified.|Given a renewal, When saved, Then a new version exists and the old one is read-only.|Given an expired contract, When items are browsed, Then they are hidden. (edge)|Given a renewal with an end date before the new start date, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract reports
requirement: Reports on contract coverage (spend on contract versus off contract per category), consumption, expiry calendar and supplier contract list.
acceptance_criteria: Given orders with and without contract references, When the coverage report runs, Then on-contract percent is shown per category.|Given export, When run, Then a file is produced.|Given no contracts, When run, Then an empty state is shown. (edge)|Given a user without the contract report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Notification keys of Contracts
requirement: Contracts shall declare its notification keys on the business layer's notification templates (BF-164), each with the event that raises it, the placeholders it offers, its default audience and an English starter template: consumption threshold reached (the contract owner, CON-021) and contract expiring, at 90, 60 and 30 days (the contract owner, CON-022).
rationale: The product knows what happens to its documents; the tenant decides, in its own words, who hears of it (BF-164). A suite's keys and starter templates are the suite's content (ADR-0043).
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant with the eProcurement Suite, When it is provisioned, Then each key of Contracts exists with its English starter template and its default audience.|Given a contract 60 days from expiry, When the job runs (CON-022), Then its owner is told in the key's template.|Given a starter template that names a placeholder its key does not offer, When the module's declarations are checked at start, Then the start fails naming the key and the placeholder. (error case)
notes: Was BF-164, the keys and starter templates of Contracts. Moved at the review of L2, 2026-10-20 (ADR-0043): each product declares its keys and starter templates; BF-164 keeps the mechanism.

title: Contracts in the portal
requirement: Suppliers shall see, read-only in the portal, the published contracts they are party to, with their items, prices, validity and remaining quantity or value.
rationale: A supplier that invoices against a contract needs its prices and the room left on it without asking the buyer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a published contract with a supplier, When the supplier opens its contracts in the portal, Then the contract is listed with its items, prices, validity and remaining quantity.|Given a contract of another supplier, When it is requested by identifier, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a contract in draft or unpublished, When the supplier lists its contracts, Then it is not shown.
notes: New at the review of the PRD split, 2026-10-20. It obeys the supplier portal's ownership rule, SPX-006 (ADR-0042).
